title: Find the release still serving
brief: Find the unhealthy shop Application and identify which revision is still serving during the failed rollout.

checks.question: Which Application is unhealthy?
checks.hint: Find the shop Application for the selected environment.
checks.why: The Applications list identifies which release needs inspection.

checks.question: What health status does this Application show?
checks.hint: Read the health badge in the Application header.
checks.why: Health shows whether the deployed workload is ready.

checks.question: Which Git revision is still serving the shop service?
checks.hint: Compare the newest History revision with the one before it. The new rollout is not ready.
checks.why: The previous ready pod keeps serving while the new revision fails readiness.

truth.cause: The new rollout is failing its readiness probe
